subject: Escalation: Pilot Plus VPC packaging discount - request for VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Amir Hassan <amir@novalytix.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot Plus — request for VPC packaging + pilot pricing

Hey Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the low-latency VPC option. We are planning a 6-week Pilot Plus (VPC, private model variant, 3 seats) and will likely expand if performance holds. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can do the following for the pilot:

- One-time onboarding credit to offset integration work (~$8k)
- 40% seat discount for the 3-seat pilot (we can commit to a 12-month evaluation if the pilot meets SLAs)
- A 6-week SOW with no minimum usage floors for the pilot period

We need a written confirmation and an SOW (we can accept DocuSign). Can you confirm internal approval path and if these concessions are acceptable?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we want to start the pilot 08/26.

Best,
Amir Hassan
VP of Engineering, Novalytix
attachments: Novalytix_requirements.xlsx (stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot Plus — request for VPC packaging + pilot pricing

Looping in RevOps and CFO for an exception request — Novalytix wants a Pilot Plus with the following exceptions:

Summary of ask (customer request):
- Onboarding credit: $8,000 one-time (to cover SPIKE integration work)
- Seat discount: 40% off list for 3 seats during 6-week pilot; customer willing to discuss a 12-month evaluation/commit if metrics pass
- No usage floor for pilot; SOW to cover 6 weeks

Business rationale (sales):
- Novalytix is a high-prospect health-tech buyer in our target vertical; good reference potential and multi-region expansion noted
- Likely $150k ARR within 12 months if pilot converts

Proposed guardrails (what I recommend):
- Approve one-time onboarding credit capped at $8k
- Approve a one-time seat discount of 35% (not 40%) for the 6-week pilot OR 40% if customer signs 12-month evaluation LOI by the pilot start
- Require an explicit conversion checkpoint and a minimum 30-day notice to withdraw pilot credits

Attachments: pricing_calc_pilotplus.xlsx (proposal), Novalytix_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW stub)

Please advise if we need VP/CFO signoff and if the proposed guardrails are sufficient. Amir has asked for confirmation by 08/14 to enable an 08/26 start.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Aug 2029 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot Plus — request for VPC packaging + pilot pricing

I support Jonas on this one — Novalytix is in our 12-month campaign and the reference value is high. Quick notes:

- Onboarding credit: OK to approve $8k one-time as a sales acceleration credit (one-off)
- Seat discount: given small seat count, 40% is steep; recommend 35% up front with an automated review at week 4 and step-up to 40% if LOI signed for 12 months by pilot week 1
- No usage floor: OK for the 6-week pilot only, documented in SOW; require an explicit conversion trigger to billing for any prorated committed spend

I attached an updated pricing calc that models revenue outcomes and the marginal cost impact. If RevOps and Finance are comfortable with the guardrails above, we should ask for a doc-sign off (DocuSign) and a light mutual action plan.

Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

- Financial impact: $8k credit + seat discount reduces ARR realization in quarter; modeled in attached approval_memo_pilotplus.docx
- Compliance: VPC deployment requires standard SOC2 evidence; ops can provision scoping in two weeks if DocuSign is executed
- Billing flow: implement one-off invoice reversal for onboarding credit if customer cancels within 30 days of pilot end

Requested approvals:
- CFO signoff to allow the 35/40% conditional seat discount + $8k onboarding credit
- RevOps signoff on billing reversal language and SOW no-floor clause

If CFO approves, I'll prepare the DocuSign packet and update the HubSpot deal (DL-2028-0957).

I've reviewed the rationale and the RevOps memo. Approval granted with conditions:

1) Approve $8,000 one-time onboarding credit.
2) Approve 35% seat discount for the initial 6-week pilot. We will allow 40% only if Novalytix signs the 12-month LOI and returns the signed LOI before pilot week 1.
3) Require the SOW to include: pilot duration (6 weeks), no usage floor clause for pilot only, conversion checkpoint at week 4, and billing reversal language for cancellations within 30 days post-pilot.
4) Legal should verify the LOI language; Sales to attach LOI as exhibit to SOW.

Dylan — proceed to prepare the DocuSign packet and HubSpot updates. Jonas — please confirm with Novalytix and get the LOI ASAP.

Kimberly Park
Chief Financial Officer
